name: trade-wars
description: E-Summit Stock Exchange - single Vercel deployment (static React frontend + Express serverless API + Postgres)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && node backend/prisma/deploy.js && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
